rows.note: Use this for the physical ability to see, rather than an aspiration or supernatural experience.

example.english: My vision is still very good.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 si6 lik6 zung6 hou2 hou2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday word for an ideal or aspiration.

example.english: My vision is to open a coffee shop.
example.traditional: 我嘅理想係開間咖啡店。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 lei5 soeng2 hai6 hoi1 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3

rows.note: Use this for forward-thinkingness or the ability to anticipate what will happen.

example.english: You need vision to do business.
example.jyutping: zou6 saang1 ji3 jiu3 jau5 jyun5 gin3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a religious or mystical supernatural appearance.

example.english: The pastor said they saw a vision while praying.
example.traditional: 牧師話佢祈禱時見到異象。
example.jyutping: muk6 si1 waa6 keoi5 kei4 tou2 si4 gin3 dou2 ji6 zoeng6
